name: DODO V2 (DVM / Crowdpooling) init() exploit: two bots front-ran the real attacker, returned funds
verdict_reason: Bot 'Antelope' (EOA 0x3554187576ec..., contract 0x00000000e84f2bbd...) beat the real attacker 'Hippo' (EOA 0x368a6558255b...) in the SAME BLOCK on two pools: block 12000022 (bot index 4 @243 gwei vs attacker index 176 @132 gwei, attacker reverted) and block 12000102 (bot index 0 @1883 gwei vs attacker index 4 @600 gwei, attacker reverted). The bot's pool.init(...) payload is byte-identical (all 8 arguments, incl. the attacker's two fake tokens FDO/FUSDT) to the attacker's; the flashLoan amounts are the same 99%-of-balance figures (differ by 99 wei). Bot 'Cheetah' (EOA 0x8a14ce0f... via proxy 0xa57bd001...) then front-ran the attacker's two WITHDRAWALS from his 'bypass' contract 0x910fd17b: its inner call to the attacker's contract is calldata byte-identical to the attacker's own pending withdraw tx (blocks 12000167 and 12000171, bot indexes 1 / 3 vs attacker indexes 77 / 78), and won a gas war against Antelope (684.25 vs 652.17 gwei). Pre-Merge: in-block evidence only; no mempool archive. Ordering is by gas price in a public gas war; no coinbase payments in any tx.
era: 2020-21 pre-Flashbots-dominance PoW; public mempool gas wars (CHI gas tokens); in-block evidence only
protocol_loss_usd: ~3.8M reported (DODO postmortem, via ChainCatcher); ~3.1M returned within 24 h by the two bots' owners; ~0.2M cashed out by the attacker; rest unrecovered

attacker.label: Mr. Hippo (DODO postmortem, address printed as '0x368')

funding_tx.source: unresolved (plain EOA transfer, not Tornado; earlier funding 0x0681bde9... 1.197 ETH from 0x8f54972f.. on 2021-03-04 and 0.466 ETH from 0x3f5ce5fb... at 11998725)

bots.label: Antelope ('Mr. Antelope'; literature sweep shortlist 'Individual B')

captured.note: block 12001452 idx 1 @93,148 gwei, fee 8.128 ETH; pool 0x236116ff was being attacked by a different EOA 0x3984e3a7 whose flashLoan (idx 23, reverted) trails; calldata not diffed -> reported-level for this one

bots.replay_evidence: Same pool, same fake tokens, same init(): pool.init(maintainer 0x95c4f5b8..., base FDO 0x7f4e7fb9..., quote FUSDT 0xf2df8794..., lpFeeRate 0x0aa87bee538000, mtFeeRateModel 0x5e84190a..., i=1, k=1e18, isOpenTWAP=0) has byte-identical calldata in Antelope's callback and in the attacker's calls (compared in 0xff9b3b2c vs 0x4bc4ace3 [reverted, same pool], 0x0b062361 vs attacker's pool-3 tx 0x395675b5). The pool.flashLoan(base, quote, assetTo, data) frames differ only in assetTo (bot contract vs attacker contract), data (640 B embedding the init payload vs 1 B) and base/quote differ by 99 wei (attacker 0xca66dd466f0b12a313ce / 0x3c8597e9aa, bot ...136b / ...947). Pool balances: attacker had just deposited 965,470.24 FDO + 262,565.01 FUSDT in the stage tx (block 12000020) -- the bot's tx needed exactly those fake tokens to pass the repay check. The bot's tx is NOT a byte copy of the attacker tx: it is an adapted replay (own contract, own callback).
bots.notes: Generalized flash-loan/arb bot (hundreds of txs/day on this EOA, CHI gas tokens burned in its DODO txs). Antelope's DODO-related captures were withdrawn to the EOA (0x89f14be6.. WSZO, 0xdf72e119.. ETHA, 0x2f989241.. wCRES) and later returned (see funds_fate). Honeypot: its own tx 0xb081e1aaf4ea7d6b819fc0ffa8230586854130e6b7313fa23a0cc4509b8c3886 at block 12007194 (97.2 gwei) fell into a trap contract 0x1ef81fb7 (trace: callback sends 0.05 ETH bait); postmortem says 324 vETH lost, amount not verified.

bots.label: Cheetah ('Mr. Cheetah')
bots.contract: 0xa57bd00134b2850b2a1c55860c9e9ea100fdd6cf (proxy shared by many EOAs, bot analysis 'a57 family'); executor 0x3a518964ff40ee733d30749a213d2e5c9ffb2b8c
bots.replay_evidence: Cheetah's tx calls executor 0x3a518964 which calls the ATTACKER'S contract: 0x910fd17b.1c03650f(USDT) (block 12000167) and 0x910fd17b.1c03650f(wCRES 0xa0afaa28...) (block 12000171). These 36-byte calldatas are byte-identical to the attacker's own pending tx data (0x14084fba..., nonce 64, to 0x910fd17b, input 0x1c03650f...dac17f95; and 0x021a2bd6..., nonce 65, ...a0afaa28...) -> equal:true. Attacker's tx landed 76 / 77 positions later at 142 / 152 gwei and received 0. This is a replay of a public victim-contract call, not of the DODO-pool exploit; the attacker's contract had an unauthenticated withdraw (per postmortem). Only the observed public call is recorded; nothing deeper decoded.
bots.notes: Cheetah's block-12001452 tx (idx 3, 19,531 gwei) lost to Antelope (idx 1) on pool 0x236116ff: tx status 1 but inner call reverted, 1.0037 ETH fee, nothing captured. Return of ~$1.89M: reported by DODO postmortem; no matching on-chain return tx located (executor 0x3a518964 is a high-volume arb contract; not found among transfers to Antelope's recipient 0xdad3e839).

other_racers.note: second, later exploiter: direct EOA init()/sync()/flashLoan on pool 0x236116ff (blocks 12001436-12001452) and pool 0x051ebd71 (12001514-12001517); both flashLoan attempts reverted (txs 0xf4cd4a9123b858fa9d387f8447a645ba52e73aa92860d035d703c79a3c0af19f, 0x19cdadac91e785b9eb8645249f184ea8c258ebd9ff3009ed9b89c44d03efd6f1). Antelope's 12001452 idx1 and 12001517/12001597 txs preceded/succeeded them; not evaluated as separate verdict.

12000167: Cheetah idx1 684.25 gwei beat Antelope idx4 652.17 gwei (Antelope's tx replays the same withdraw(USDT) call 0x910fd17b.1c03650f(USDT) then USDT.transfer(own EOA) and ran out of gas, tx 0xbfe6df9308df38661b817cb56da5cacca468e894472a291d6e17d2eb7ab4e24b). Fee wasted by Antelope 0.1384 ETH.
init()/sync() and one reverted flashLoan on pool 0xfb609b68 after the main events; likely recovery attempts or copycats; not classified.

funds_fate.what: Antelope returns to 0xdad3e839ba4a48faf54f3aa187d8b6b8646e6224 (recipient presumed DODO recovery wallet; it later disburses to project parties)
funds_fate.note: returned ~28-34 h after the takes. Antelope had swapped USDT through the 1inch router (261,373 USDT in 0x6f760495..., 326,070 USDT in 0x3eddb8b3... to 0xe069cb01); 298,044.73 USDT came back from 0xe069cb01 at 12007457 and 296,009 USDT was returned. Full reconciliation of the 586k USDT taken vs returned (114.5 ETH also returned) not done.
reported returned (~$1.89M) around 2021-03-09 13:00 UTC; return tx not located

funds_fate.amount: 21,379.23 USDT + 9,437.95 DODO (12000302); USDT 59,245 sent to 0xe877151f at 12000330; ~$200k total per postmortem, part to a CEX that froze it
funds_fate.note: Hippo's three big takes (pools 1-3) were all captured by bots
all gas-price bids; coinbase transfers 0 in every tx; Antelope 12001452 tx alone 8.13 ETH; 12000102 0.26 ETH; Cheetah 12001452 1.00 ETH

auction.note: No relays/slots. Race decided by gas price in the public mempool (bot txs at indexes 0-4 of their blocks); blocks mined by uupool.cn, eth-pro-hzo, ethermine, nanopool etc. Flashbots blocks API HTTP 410; inferred_bundle_like heuristic true for the focus txs only because the project's heuristic flags low-index high-gas txs -- coinbase_transfer is 0 for all, so no evidence of MEV-geth bundles. Mempool first-seen: none (mempool archive starts 2023-08-07).

discrepancies: ChainCatcher's account of the postmortem says Mr. Hippo 'executed two attacks, but both were front-run by Mr. Antelope's bot' then wrote a bypass contract; on-chain: two stage+attack pairs (pools 1 and 2) front-run by Antelope, then contract #4 0x910fd17b did stage+attack in one tx on pool 3 and succeeded (12000165), then Cheetah took the proceeds. Matches.

ChainCatcher says Antelope's bot was 'spending as much as 90,000 gWei in gas price to send the transaction, with a single transaction miner fee reaching 8 ETH': tx 0x561f7ccb... (93,148.7 gwei, 8.128 ETH) is NOT on a pool Hippo attacked; it is the pool 0x236116ff race with 0x3984e3a7.
candidates.json claimed the 3 bot analysis shortlist incident txs for Antelope all copy the attacker; verified only for 0xff9b3b2c and 0x0b062361; 0x561f7ccb is a different race.
headline_text: Antelope, a generic flash-loan bot, replayed the DODO attacker's init() call at index 4 of block 12000022 and took 955,815 WSZO + 259,939 USDT; the attacker's tx at index 176 reverted. Antelope later returned most of its takes. Pre-Merge, in-block evidence only.

harmonized.verdict_reason: Antelope's init() calldata is byte-identical to the attacker's; bot idx 4 (243 gwei) vs attacker idx 176 (132 gwei) in 12000022; the attacker's tx reverted.
